title: MAP-S02-03 - Cargo Reclaimer Ambush Battlefield
hook: The road tightens into an ambush site: mud under the carriage wheels, thorn cover on both sides, and figures moving between the brush and the cargo line. The path forward is blocked by people, not beasts.
